*Updated 2026-10-10 · 118 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and eighteen works. The October 10 piece scores 2, and the last twelve now read 2, 3, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2 — the same sequence as last cycle, median still 2, no 4 since July 29. That drought is now nineteen weeks, and the flatline is structural: the images are compositionally resolved but the friction that lifts a score isn't arriving.

Camera position is the most stalled variable in the archive. Straight-on sits at 27 all-time, overhead at 12, from-behind at 10, low-angle at 4. The last twelve show two overhead frames and nothing else off-axis. Low-angle has not appeared in the recent window at all. When the camera sits below the focal object, scale violation becomes a physical consequence of the optic rather than an imposed decision, and the viewer's spatial relationship to the frame becomes structural rather than observational. The four 4-scored works in the archive each produced friction between a body and a misscaled object, but low-angle combined with figure-at-mismatched-scale has still never been attempted as a deliberate pairing. That combination remains the single most actionable change available and it has not moved.

Figure count is holding exactly flat. The last twelve show two frames with no figures, two with one, two with two or more — identical to the previous window. The October 8 surgical trolley piece had two figures and still landed at 2, confirming that a second figure placed decoratively rather than structurally adds count without adding pressure. Two figures in genuine spatial opposition, shot from below, have not been tried.

Registers have narrowed further. Menace leads the recent window at 3 of 12, defiance and suspension at 2 each, aftermath at 2. Reckoning last appeared in July. Reprieve last appeared in July. Encroachment appeared once in September. Exhaustion has surfaced twice all-time and not since June. Impotence once across the entire archive. These registers have not gone dormant because they've been exhausted — they've gone dormant by default, and each carries enough structural distance from the current cluster to generate genuine friction if the anchor warrants it.

Descriptor coverage stands at 36 of 118 — still less than a third of the archive carries structured descriptors, so computed figure counts and focal objects rest on a minority of frames. The work is disciplined and plateaued in equal measure; the camera is where the ceiling breaks, and it has not moved.
